description: Feature value and check answer decoding (sections 6.2 and 8). Serve answer with headers as a 200 for request, a check on a server client with an empty cache, and compare the decoded check with outcome. Value cases give one feature value and its decoded kind, or null when it does not decode and the check fails with an ApiError, code invalid_response; check cases give the fields an SDK exposes, with absent naming the fields the answer lacks and an enum value this version does not know as { "unknown": raw }; instant cases give one instant of the answer, at field, and its decoded instant, or the decoding failure; field cases put json, a JSON value of a type the schema does not take (a quoted number or boolean included), at field, a dotted path into answer, or leave field out of answer when missing is true, so the check fails with the ApiError invalid_response.

cases.name: on
cases.why: JSON true is the on value.

cases.name: on-off-not-entitled
cases.why: An on/off feature the customer is not entitled to answers the amount 0, so on/off answers take the whole value type.

cases.name: amount-zero
cases.why: Zero is an amount, not off; entitled comes from the server.

cases.name: amount-five
cases.why: A whole number is an amount.

cases.name: amount-max-safe-integer
cases.why: 2^53 − 1 is the largest amount and decodes exactly.

cases.name: unlimited
cases.why: The string unlimited is the unlimited value.

cases.name: invalid-negative
cases.why: A negative number is not an amount.

answer.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: invalid-fraction
cases.why: A fraction is not a whole number.

answer.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: invalid-other-string
cases.why: A string other than unlimited is not a value.

answer.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: invalid-capitalised-unlimited
cases.why: unlimited is matched exactly, in lower case.

answer.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: invalid-numeric-string
cases.why: A number in a string is not an amount.

answer.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: invalid-null
cases.why: null is not a value.

answer.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: invalid-false
cases.why: Only JSON true is the on value; false is not one of the three kinds.

answer.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: invalid-object
cases.why: An object is not a value.

answer.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: check-on-off
cases.why: An on/off check with an unknown top-level field, an unknown nested field and an unknown environment kind.

cases.name: check-metered
cases.why: A metered check exposes used, remaining, held and resetsAt (given with an offset), alongside an unknown field and an unknown experiment arm.

cases.name: check-metered-unlimited
cases.why: A metered check with unlimited value and remaining, no reset, on a track following a change, with an unknown field.

cases.name: check-unknown-feature-type
cases.why: A feature type this SDK does not know is kept as an unknown case and still decodes.

cases.name: check-on-off-not-entitled
cases.why: A typed on/off check keeps the whole value type: not entitled, it answers the amount 0 with entitled false.

cases.name: check-sent-as-text-plain
cases.why: Decoding never depends on Content-Type, so a JSON answer labelled text/plain decodes.

cases.name: check-without-content-type
cases.why: Decoding never depends on Content-Type, so a JSON answer without one decodes.

cases.name: instant-first-year
cases.why: The first instant of year 0001 is inside RFC 3339's range and decodes.

cases.name: instant-last-year
cases.why: The last millisecond of year 9999 is inside RFC 3339's range and decodes.

cases.name: instant-year-zero
cases.why: Year 0000 is outside years 0001 to 9999, so the answer does not decode.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: instant-five-digit-year
cases.why: A five-digit year is outside years 0001 to 9999, so the answer does not decode.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: instant-year-zero-in-resets-at
cases.why: The year range applies to every instant, so a resetsAt in year 0000 fails the whole answer.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: check-environment-kind-in-capitals
cases.why: Enum values are matched exactly, so Live is a kind this version does not know, kept as its raw string.

cases.name: entitled-a-quoted-boolean
cases.why: A quoted boolean is a string, not a boolean, so entitled "true" does not decode.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: entitled-missing
cases.why: A check without entitled lacks a field the document requires, so it does not decode.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: release-a-quoted-number
cases.why: A quoted number is a string, not an integer, so release "2" does not decode.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: testers-a-number
cases.why: testers must be a boolean, so 1 does not decode.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: used-a-quoted-number
cases.why: A meter's used given as the quoted number "250" does not decode.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: remaining-a-quoted-number
cases.why: remaining is an amount or unlimited, so the quoted number "700" does not decode.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: environment-kind-a-number
cases.why: An enum is an open set of strings, so a kind that is a number is another JSON type and does not decode.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: as-of-a-number
cases.why: An instant is an RFC 3339 string, so asOf given as milliseconds since 1970 does not decode.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: upgrades-an-object
cases.why: upgrades is an array, so an object in its place does not decode.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.
